text:
lucas: Heads-up: we're scheduling a cascade maintenance for apac-south1-a/b this Sunday 01:30-04:00 UTC. Reason: NIC driver hotpatch + kernel CVE backport. Expect rolling drains in small cohorts, not full pool drains. :wrench:

jen: Can you share cohort sizes? need to coordinate warm cache seeding and canary traffic.

lucas: Cohorts = 8 nodes each, ~16 GPUs per cohort. Plan: 01:30 start apac-south1-a cohort-1, then every 20m next cohort. apac-south1-b begins ~02:45 to keep one AZ warm.

maria: We should use cascade instead of full cordon so we maintain warm KV prefixes. I'll run a KV affinity pass between cohorts.

kai: Kernel hotpatch details? will this require reboots or livepatch only?

lucas: It's a livepatch + one brief kernel reboot to switch to new module path for the NIC driver on affected nodes. Reboot time ~90s, but drain+evac will add ~7-10m per node.

jen: I'll queue the prime script after each cohort:`
curl -s -X POST https://internal/api/prime -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" -d '{"pools":["saturn","venus"],"qps":6,"duration_s":600}'
`

maria: Routing rules: we'll prefer same-AZ, then same-region cross-AZ, finally fallback cross-region to us-west1 with `latency_threshold=175ms`. Tenants with Dedicated reservations excluded.

ops-bot: Maintenance object created: mnt-20260605-cascade-apac-south1. Status page updated.

lucas: Cost ask: propose spinning up 6 spare GPUs in us-west1 for 3 hours as buffer while apac drains. Ballpark = $840.jen ok with budget?

jen: approve for availability. please tag cost center infra-prod. I'll post to #finance.

kai: Are we good on canary traffic? suggest a 15m canary after cohort-2 before proceeding.

maria: agree. Canary steps: 1) route 5% traffic to cohort nodes; 2) run synthetic latency checks and model correctness evals; 3) proceed if < 5% tail latency increase.

lucas: Preflight checklist tonight 20:00 UTC: `kubectl get nodes -l cohort=apac-south1-a -o wide`, verify spare capacity, confirm livepatch image present on nodes.

oncall-bot: Reminder set for mnt-20260605-cascade-apac-south1: notifications at 60m and 15m. Pager only if error-rate > 10% sustained for 5m.

jen: One more ask: can we avoid running the DB final swap during cohort-3? that overlaps with customer backup windows.

lucas: yes - we'll schedule the final migration swap during cohort-5 when traffic is lowest.

maria: I'll publish tenant-impact doc and tag SRE owners. Also will include rollback steps: `fleetctl uncordon`, `kubectl rollout undo` for agent if patch causes packet loss.

jen: :thumbsup: prepping monitoring dashboards and traces.

kai: I'll be oncall during the window. ping me on pager if packet drops > 2% per node.

lucas: thanks all. closing here, will post the Confluence runbook + explicit node lists. react with :white_check_mark: when you reviewed the runbook.

maria: :white_check_mark:

jen: :white_check_mark:
